versions.changelog: Sync verified source 7c70e32. JishuDB setup 0.1.22 verifies host registration, preserves installer handoff, and supports signed CNB catalog renewals.

jishudb-mcp-check 0.1.4

- Clarified intended usage: for explicit acceptance/smoke tests only, not for setup or standard queries.
- Updated safety, workflow, and approval rules for both read-only and all-tools acceptance runs.
- Expanded documentation on result states, preflight checks, execution order, and cleanup requirements.
- Improved instructions for handling missing capabilities, contract drift, and tool catalog changes.
- Enhanced section on agent behavior when prerequisites are absent or a connector is blocked.
